name: godot
description: Godot 4 skills that carry only what a model gets wrong from memory: the 4.3–4.7 inversions (Jolt Physics 3D as the default for new projects since 4.6, the 4.7 GDScript override and packed-array changes, flipped defaults), multiplayer authority, visibility and auth footguns, web-export and C# limits; a headless GDScript test runner that exits non-zero on failure; and a standard-library Python checker for broken res:// paths, uids and scene references. Pairs with gamedev.
